description.value: The 2400 Motel is a mid-century motor court dating to 1946, set on 3.5 acres of landscaped grounds along Vancouver's Kingsway corridor in the Collingwood neighbourhood. Its 65 rooms and bungalows follow a detached layout with private entrances and free parking right at the door — an atmospheric alternative to high-rise hotels and a recognizable filming location for movies and TV. Touring cyclists will find it conveniently placed near transit, restaurants, and a mall, with pet-friendly rooms and full kitchens available in select units.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The 2400 Motel website is fully accessible and confirms it is an active, 80-year-old motor court motel at 2400 Kingsway, Vancouver. The FAQ page explicitly contradicts the OSM air_conditioning=yes tag (website says no AC due to 1946 electrical panels) and the OSM internet_access:fee=customers tag (website prominently advertises FREE WIFI). No mention of bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) appears anywhere on the site; EV charging is confirmed but is framed as vehicle charging rather than e-bike charging.
concerns: OSM tag air_conditioning=yes contradicts website FAQ which explicitly states no AC ('our electrical panels cannot handle modern AC units').
OSM tag internet_access:fee=customers (implying paid Wi-Fi) contradicts website which advertises FREE WIFI.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible motel operating for 80 years at the listed address, with a functioning website and confirmed contact details.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the Kingsway/Collingwood neighbourhood has 'lots of shops, restaurants, and a mall' nearby
